why: Safety hooks intercept and veto commands before execution, preventing credential extraction, destructive disk commands, and escape vectors before they can reach the isolated guest microVM runtime, while incurring negligible sub-millisecond policy evaluation overhead.

Celesto network policy enforces kernel-level egress filtering and complete outbound network isolation, guaranteeing that prompt-injection exfiltration payloads cannot transmit data even if commands bypass application-layer filters, at the trade-off of requiring pre-cached package dependencies.
